page_title: INT 3-1 CAG | Inter v Cagliari 12/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' The Inter players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

88' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
86' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
84' Substitution. Hakan Calhanoglu leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kristjan Asllani (Inter).
83' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
83' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle and signals a foul after Matteo Darmian (Inter) brought his opponent down. A free kick has been awarded to Cagliari.
82' Substitution. Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) replaces Roberto Piccoli.

81' Yann Bisseck (Inter) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
81' There's an opportunity for Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
81' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
80' Inter are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
79' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
79' Cagliari work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
76' Marcus Thuram (Inter) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman signals a throw-in for Inter.
74' Cagliari seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
73' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) replaces Alessandro Deiola.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Adam Obert (Cagliari) is coming onto the pitch as Gabriele Zappa cannot continue after picking up an injury.
71' Wonderful movement by Inter. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
69' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
67' Here is a change. Nicola Zalewski is going off and Simone Inzaghi gives the last tactical orders to Alessandro Bastoni (Inter).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lautaro Martinez departs the field of play to be replaced by Marcus Thuram (Inter).
67' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
66' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
63' Inter showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
62' It's time for a substitution. Razvan Marin (Cagliari) comes on in place of Antoine Makoumbou.
62' Substitution. Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) on for Florinel Coman.
60' Simone Inzaghi has decided to substitute Federico Dimarco and he is replaced by Matteo Darmian (Inter).
59' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Marko Arnautovic walks off the pitch to be replaced by Joaquin Correa (Inter).

59' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Cagliari are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
58' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cagliari comes to nothing.

57' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Cagliari force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

55' 3 - 1 A perfectly taken corner kick. Yann Bisseck (Inter) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes inside the left post, increasing the score of today's match – 3:1.
55' Federico Dimarco (Inter) will take a corner kick.

55' Federico Dimarco (Inter) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. Inter will take a corner kick.

55' Federico Dimarco (Inter) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Elia Caprile reacts superbly to deny him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Inter.
52' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Yann Sommer was alert and made a comfortable save.
50' Inter are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
48' 2 - 1 Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header into the roof of the net. Excellent finish.
48' Cagliari keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball. The ball is out of play. Cagliari will have a throw-in.

46' Inter slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
46' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Federico Dimarco (Inter) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Federico Dimarco (Inter) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
43' A cross by Federico Dimarco (Inter) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
40' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Lautaro Martinez (Inter), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
38' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
36' Wonderful movement by Cagliari. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
34' The resulting set piece from Cagliari is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
34' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman makes the right call and Cagliari will have a corner.
34' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
32' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
30' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The ball is behind the touchline and Inter will take a throw-in.
28' Inter keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
26' 2 - 0 GOAL! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Elia Caprile, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 2:0.
25' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
24' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
23' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Marco Di Bello blows for a foul.
22' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) latches on to a cross and produces a snap shot from outside of the box. His shot flies just wide of the goal.
19' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Nicola Zalewski (Inter) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

16' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Cagliari are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
13' 1 - 0 Marko Arnautovic (Inter) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes the ball into the roof of the net. What a lovely finish!
12' Cagliari show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. It's a throw-in for Cagliari.
10' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
8' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
6' Inter are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
4' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
3' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Nicolo Barella (Inter). Marco Di Bello saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
2' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
1' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Inter will take the kick-off.
Marco Di Bello was nominated as the referee for this game.
